text: I hadn't been here since I was a kid. It had easily been ten or so years. While it wasn't as good as I remembered, the food was still much better than the Chipotle down the street. They gave us really good portions, the food was fresh, and the employees were nice. They also weren't particularly busy so we were in and out of there in no time. I will likely be returning in the next few weeks.
Absolutely the best Mexican restaurant in town. The habanero salsa is the best salsa I've ever had and the "pico" cabbage salsa is a really good twist.

The food here is fantastic! Their veal parm is delicious. I also love the limoncello cake. My only complaint is about the owner/manager. She's very racist. I have friends who have worked there, and they have told me she uses racial slurs and dislikes anyone who is not white. The last time I ate there, she would not stop staring at me. If I didn't know about what she's said behind closed doors, I wouldn't have payed it any mind. It's such a shame. I would keep coming here because the food is spectacular, but I'll just take my money somewhere else.

The best spot in Nashville!!  OMG what a find!!!  The best music and not crazy overfilled Broadway St bars.  This is a MUST DO in Nashville!  As much as Nashville hot chicken!!  

Bar staff is SUPER friendly!!  We saw 4 single acoustic singer songwriters sitting next to each other singing singles...  WOW!!  And then later these effing guys!!!!  Mind Blown!!!!  Best entertaining music, drinks and friendly environment!!!!

Food's always great here. I've been leery to come back - Not going to indoor restaurants much during Covid. But they're doing a lot of things right: Taking temp and offering hand sanitizer at the door, tables are distanced, staff are masked. And breakfast is still great as always!

I gave this place two chances. The first time I ordered brown stew chicken and the second time I ordered oxtails. Both times the food was very bland and had a weird sweet after taste. The place is clean, staff appears courteous and friendly but they definitely need a better chef. It's a No for me.

We have passed this place several times but never stopped. Tonight we decided to give TJ's a try. It was great! I had grouper piccata and it was the best I ever had. My wife loved her spaghetti and clams in red sauce. The ambiance is surprising top notch fora beach place. We will be back! Our server was April. She was very attentive.

We had 1 hr. The waitress brought water and onion ring appetizers. I asked for all the food at once since we were limited on time. Then we waited and waited. I got her attention and asked again. She brought the steak and fries 40 minutes later.... and stated, "You have to let me know when you order if you want it all at once." 
Now get this- I DID. Plus there were 3 other customers in the whole place.
I asked for a box. She brought one the size of a piece of pie. I asked for one the size of the meal. She huffed and then brought one. 
She then said , "I suppose you want a bag too."
Needless to say.... NO TIP.
When I got home the Steak tasted like FISH which I am allergic to... the dog got it and I cooked dinner.
Worst experience in years!

I tried Splash Poke's Take Home Poke Bake. It's a new item that Splash Poke created during the covid-19 quarantine. It is a great creation!

There are currently 4 types you can choose from. This item is basically a poke that you order to take home and then you would broil it in your oven for 3-5 minutes. It is a warm poke and it is absolutely delicious. The dish comes in a oven safe tin and it has protein with sauce layered over rice. It also comes with some  seaweed sheets that you can use to eat the poke with. 

I ordered the Spicy Tuna Bake and Umami Seafood Bake. My favourite one was the Umami Bake. The Spicy Tuna Bake was just a spicier version of the Umami Bake so I wish I ordered another bake instead because they tasted pretty similar. The tins are a bit small and costs $12.95 each. I ordered from Ubereats so it ended up being around $15 each so it was a bit expensive. Overall my family enjoyed the poke bakes and I would order it again.

Ordered pizza and a salad to go. Such a disappointment to what we got. The pizza was burnt, no cheese and no sauce on the pizza. The only reason I'm giving a 3 star is bc of previous times we have eaten there are normally good.

Every once in a while you'll eat something and you can't get it out of your mind. This place will do that! I never thought I would like eastern Indian cuisine. I love this place! Flavors are off the charts! This family owned business will greet you with open arms, refreshing after being in places where they don't seem to care if your there or not. All the food is freshly made with healthy fresh ingredients another rare trait in Reno/sparks. Definitely worth a try.

Possibly the worst pizza ever.
Ketchup on crackers is about what it was and that would've been better.

The long awaited masterpiece of a restaurant from Chef Nick Bognar did not disappoint! We had the honmaguro which is always insanely good at Nippon Tei and it was equally as fantastic. We tried the shrimp toast which was crunchy, savory and a bit spicy. We have never had anything like it and it was a delicious surprise. We finished with a rich, sumptuous curried beef short rib dish that knocked our socks off. Served with labne and roti, it was truly unforgettable. Nick is a brilliant chef and all around nice guy. Cant wait to go back!
Wow! From the moment I walked in, I knew the food would not disappoint. And boy, it did not! This is my new go to Indian food location. Clean and the service was quick.  You will not be disappointed!

Had great drinks at a very good price.  Food was on par with good bar food.  4 stars for location right between the islands and the views of the ocean watching pelicans feed.  Also had some fun with the birds at the resteraunt.  Very nice.
Amazing food and service.  The view over the city was great.  I will say that any time I'm in Nashville I will make it a priority to eat at this amazing restaurant.

Just had dinner and I do really like this place. The meatballs are awesome!! My issues are the tables(booths). The table clothes are way to long makes it incredibly difficult to get in and out plus as a woman who likes to cross my legs I cannot; The table is very low. 
Also my waiter assumed that all the money in my bill was for him. He never brought me change and it made it a 45% tip which wasn't my intention but he clearly needed it so I just left. 
This is my 5th time there and will be back but not for a while. I will probably try somewhere new

This is a great spot to get a bowl of steaming hot pho and just about anything else . I really loved the eggplant with black bean stir fry. I usually get barbecue pork with it but, you can have chicken , beef, or pork. YUMMIE !!

Without a doubt, this is the best Indian food I've ever had, and I've had quite a lot since I first discovered it in London, England back in 2000. Prior to COVID-19, I had to drive to the restaurant to get my Indian fix so I'm *extremely* happy they've extended their delivery radius to include Kuna, Idaho. Amazing food. I highly recommend it!

Hullo!

We were passing through SB a few weeks back when we came across this pizza place. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful and the pizza was delicious! I highly recommend the pizza, but the cheesy herb bread wasn't that great.
The best sushi in bucks.  Yummmmmmmmmmm. Fast n friendly service. Wish Covid was over so we could get something other then take out

Pleasantly surprised at the delicious food. The prime rib was as good as anything I've had in Arizona. The veggies weren't overdone and soft like most restaurants 
   Dakota is a major asset as a server. Attentive , smiling I'm assuming ( damn masks) and extremely seems to enjoy her job. Thanks for the great lunch
Food is ok.  I have heard good things about this place.  Staff was amazing. Came in with large party and they were blue to help

This place was so amazing. I already can't wait to go back for more. First of all the waitstaff were all very nice and knowledgeable which greatly enhanced the dining experience! We order way to much food (to the point where we only had one bite of our last course) but we're just as thrilled that we got to take it home and have left overs! I seriously can not say enough about how tasty the food was. The nigiri was top notch and I personally think the short rib red curry is a can't miss must order. It is so rich and creamy and pairs perfectly with the flaky bread. We were able to sit outside on their enclosed patio which is very cutely decorated and includes heat lamps. Highly recommend to anyone looking for some amazing food!

Me and my friends are at this sandwich place late at night. Was exceptional except for how there was racist regulars. When a group of us did not stand for racist remarks we got escorted out instead of the racist couple. We were extremely hurt by the actions of the staff and hope the best in terms of a more accepting future. Me and my friends have love for this region and this is the first time we ever experienced hate in terms of our skin color and culture. Do better, we all deserve a second chance.

I paid 375 for a cinnamon roll and it was stale can I believe it first of all they're not that good but still I cannot believe it, then when I called them they put me on hold with a bunch of bad music, when they finally did answer the phone again he said all check on that and then I told her I'm gonna yell up to her

Bread - excellent and fresh as it should be 5/5

Salad - basic 4/5

Fried string beans - this is a pretty basic dish but the addition of the red sauce was pretty good and worked well 5/5

The salmon - the salmon itself was pretty good, tasted fresh. I didn't order the vegetables, this was the choice of somebody else I was dining with.  4/5

Beef short rib over risotto topped with shoestring onion rings- honestly this dish was just overly complicated... It was like two separate dishes were combined into one. The beef short ribs were great (fall off the bone) but then the risotto was overpowering... And then an additional overpowering onion taste from the shoestring onions... 
The items individually were great... Eating this meal I just felt like I didn't want to eat anymore, it was just everything slopped together, which actually ruined the flavor of the individual components.
The dish itself 1/5 

Steak with shrimp on top - the dish just felt like it was slathered and sauce with shrimp on top... And then there was spaghetti mixed into it. Again really not sure what was going on here.
The spaghetti with all the sauce and shrimp could have made a perfect separate dish.
I don't know if I should be upset with myself for ordering a steak at an Italian restaurant in South Jersey, or confused at the multiple dishes pressed into  one... Overall this dish just felt sloppy and unappetizing - 1/5

Manicotti - good shells, good sauce, good ricotta. Very few places actually make manicotti
Great food, great staff, and an awesome environment! One of my favorite spots in the city!
Everytime I come here, the food is always great and the atmosphere is clean . The other location is the one I use to go to but they closed it for construction. Amazing vegan food and people

This place makes great frozen yogurt, and there are a lot of options available for toppings. Staff are friendly and helpful, and they were wearing masks and enforcing a limited number of people inside. There's outdoor seating, but we decided to eat our yogurt near the car.

Unfortunately, it doesn't seem that they have gluten-free toppings available, but the yogurt itself tastes great. Not a lot of space for parking or inside, but it's more grab-and-go than somewhere you stick around.

Really charming sushi spot! I'm not totally sure if they still offer their Tuesday happy hour deals on sushi, but if so- that's the time to go. It's really busy during that time, and it creates a really fun atmosphere!  We always loved to squeeze in at the bar if there was room and watch the staff prepare our sushi order. The rolls are a tad on the smaller size, but they are still really delicious. Our favorite rolls were always the spicy scallop and spicy octopus. We hope to go back someday to STL!

This is a hidden gem. We came here after searching for nearby pasta places and found this business. The pasta plates are about $7.99 to make your own dish. So you choose your noodles and sauce. I got regular spaghetti looking noodles and carbonara sauce. It was delicious. That's not the best part... it comes with garlic bread! It was also delicious. You can also add meats for extra charge. Will definitely be coming here again for a yummy and cheap pasta craving.

We dove in deep on the small plates and yakitori. If I go again, that is where I will keep my ordering! Personally.

It was time to eat intuitively and my body needed serious protein after a long drive and day. We throughly enjoyed the Pork Belly and Salmon Nanbanzuke. However, I wasn't a fan of the JFC. I was exporting a fried chicken with Korean dressing but it was dry. The spice was tasty. But I'm not a dry chicken person. For those who enjoy that, it will be pleasurable. 

The ramen didn't impress me as I hoped. The pork belly was basically noodles. And, for many people, they like their ramen that way. I'm not a noodle or pasta person. I'm also bias. I love our hometown Asian Fushion Ramen, Mirin. They add more greens, shrooms and such which helps me enjoy the noodles more! 

But all in all, the cocktails were good, but sweet. The house made sochu was good as well.

Having been on the quest for the best Pastrami Reuben in America for most of my life, turns out that I didn't need do all of that testing in NYC, Palm Beach County OR the entire Northeast, because the BEST pastrami on the planet is RIGHT HERE in Tampa????? I cant even describe with words how tender and  delicious this was! It's like I didnt even have to chew it! And the potato salad? Equally legit! I'm FLOORED. I could totally see this place on Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives...its THAT good!

Excellent food, lots of it and a great price!
Service was great and when our Apple Cobbler didn't come out the way they liked it they made another and took it off the bill. Then they gave us a coupon for $13 to come back! That's a great way to run a business!
Nice spot especially in the summer. My husband and I love to go here for brunch and order mimosas while people watching. A must go to

Just a heads up. I'd like to suggest that no one patronize the Hilton Hotel on City Ave. I booked my daughters wedding there for 250 people. We are now told that we are only allowed to have 50 people. We gave a deposit of $5000.00 and have a large dollar amount minimum to meet for the wedding. There is no way that we are able to meet that minimum with 50 guests. 
The contract states that if the venue can't provide the service due to may things, one of which is Government Restrictions, they have a right to cancel. They can not accommodate us for her wedding due to the Government Restrictions and are refusing to refund our deposit.
Their solution is for the kids to move their wedding to next year. That is not an option. My daughter and her fiance want to be married 12/5. It will be immediate family only. I think that this is wrong on many levels.

Sam's Kabab Gyro is as much an experience as it is a meal. I walked into this fast food gyro place to find a smiling man behind the counter singing and dancing to the music playing in the background, a huge smile upon his face. Well, that smile and good nature proved to be infectious and soon I was smiling at this friendly man's overall happy go lucky attitude.

I opted for the gyro platter, which was very generous portioned, especially considering the price point was under $8.00.

My food was quickly prepared and was very good. I enjoyed this easy meal a d watched with humor as the man behind the counter greeted each customer with his smiling song and dance.

I will say that I am very happy that I chose to try here and would recommend that you try here, as well. I am confident that you will enjoy not only the food, but the experience as a whole.

This is my coworker's go-to place so I've been thinking about going here for quite some time. Darling area of the City! They are building a great community in that area. 

We sat inside because it's a million degrees outside but in hindsight, we should have sat on the shaded patio!! Inside was great too. We had a nice view of the desserts. Plus it was nice and cool! 

I had the Lola's Breakfast Sandwich. It was a scrambled egg, bacon and cheese on a toasted bun. It was very tasty! Just the right amount of eggs, bacon and cheese to make it the perfect egg sandwich. I will most likely order it again the next time I go there. 

It was served with chips or a fruit cup. I selected the fruit cup. The fruit was cut to bite sized pieces and all of it was good. Strawberries, cantaloupe, grapefruit and grapes made up the fruit. Sorry if I'm forgetting one. 

I forgot to snap photos. I'm always a bit too eager for my food. Ha! I did snap some photos of the dessert cases. 

Service was good. They were attentive but not overly attentive. We could carry on a nice conversation without interruptions. 

I look forward to going back to this lovely restaurant. I can see why my coworker goes again and again. 

PS - They were doing a nice job to prevent the spread of Covid.
HG is our weekly go to for wood fired pizza, Greek salad and garlic knots or wings. Always fresh and delicious. My favorite pizza is the Half Moon Bay or the Margarita Especiale. Plus they deliver!

No masks on employees!! Wednesday Nov 4th 6:40 pm. I pull up right in front of the store . 4 employees working 3 have masks on as chin guards not covering there mouths even completely pulled down under their chins . 1 employee doesn't even have a mask on in any sorts . Didn't even go inside to pick up my order turned my car back on and left . Ridiculous when we are having a higher Covid resurgence and you are charging $$$ for food . They are not cheap . So when the owner reads this here's the run down on exactly what your employees are doing. 1 completely mask-less heavier set white male with a short buzzed haircut behind the register having a spirited conversation with another taller white male and a shorter white female behind the counter on the right side of the store (both of theses employees have masks but they are pulled down under their chin not covering their mouth)
As I'm contemplating walking in and addressing the issue another employee a Hispanic male comes walking from the back carrying something also with a mask pulled under his chin completely exposing his mouth as well . Only thing I'm regretting is not taking a picture from the car as more proof for buyers to beware. After ordering the big daddy combo and tipping every time normally comes to 90$ + I will never return to this establishment. Maybe once Covid is gone but for now this is completely irresponsible to be running a food business and having the employees handling food and running a register with no mas

The food was absolutely delicious and even better people.  Once they found out about my wife's fathers passing, they wouldn't accept our money in our time in need, cant beat that. Needless to say they gained lifelong customers from the gesture.

Why McDonalds doesn't get this owner under control is beyond me. The previous owner really cared about this store. It was always sparkling, his staff was always neat, clean, spoke good English and were taught that the customer comes first. This was lost with the current owner. Once in a while when the few really good people are working, it's good and th ey're very helpful.
They know me. I'm old, walk with a cane so when the inside was open they would bring over my oder so I didn't have to try the balancing act along with my cane.
All day breakfast is now gone with our current situation and the menu is even smaller! It's very hard for me to try to get there before 10:30 and I'm not sure if they are even making biscuit sandwiches which I freeze and eat one ever other day. The menu still shows all day breakfast. 
Is it too difficult to change that reflecting the current emergency in our nation? No, yet the old one remains!
Owner, spend 10 minutes and have the menu updated, it's not that hard!

GO TO THIS PLACE!!  Recently visited as a pre party for meetup at the movies...our group quickly grew from 6 to 13 without a reservation. Hostess stand was amazing to accomodate us as we were on a time schedule. The original 6 arrived at 545 and we had the movie in the shopping center at 7. Was impressed that we were seated and menus in hand by 6, our waiter was equally awesome as he had our drink and food order by 615 with food arriving by 630   KITCHEN CREW ROCKS there also!!!! Must comment that the food quality was on point amazing. I had the turkey sandwich which was fresh slow roasted breast, not the expected sliced deli style meat with a nice Amaroso roll. the other diners had awesome looking and tasting food as well..will have to go back and sample the BEER!!   JUST GO
Pricey, but the food is good. They give you side dishes before your meal and always attentive when your water cup is low. There is also a cute cafe next door for after dinner.
Favorite Indian restaurant for take out in the area. Love their Biryani. All the south Indian dishes are pretty authentic.

Rode our bikes out here last night for bike gang. It felt like biking up a mountain. 

I got a lemonade and a brisket cheese steak. It was really good and unlike most parks on tap food, actually filling. 

Plenty of space between benches and chairs. No over crowding. No lines. 

Bathrooms were super clean. Sanitized pens to sign your name after paying. All the proper precautions. 

This has been my favorite parks on tap experience.
One of my favorite  spots for good Asian of god. Everything is always fresh and hot when it's delivered and they are really quick as well.

We love hawkers, but it always takes so long for our server to see us when we sit down. It took 10 minutes our last visit to even have a staff member see us at our table. We have an issue getting seated every time we come to this restaurant. We get told it's an hour wait for a table outside when there are 4 open tables not cleared yet. Madison the waitress took her own time to clear a table for us and seat us within 10 minutes. She deserves Credit for her work. Thank you Madison!
This place is consistently great. The only thing that would make it better is if they offered ranch. I'm not a big fan of the sauces they have. The food is always very fresh and the service is great.

Never heard of this place till my roommate mentioned it. Came it for a birthday dinner. First of all getting into this place is pretty cool! You have to dial the number and wait till they come and get you! They literally have a red phone booth in front. The inside is fancy and has a classic touch. There is a dress code for this place. (You should probably dress up). They didn't have many food items as this place is new (3 months). They have pizza and dessert. They have a long drink list as well.
I got the pizza and it was great! Brick oven pizza ftw! Met the chef later and he said he popped it in the oven at 900 degrees and the pizza is done in no time! If you walk to the back you can see the brick oven from the room that has a Pool table! Yes they have a pool table! Then the drinks were amazing! I stuck to the whiskey section and it didn't disappoint! Will definitely recommend! Would love to come back again and try the other drinks and food items (once the menu is fully ready). Hopefully I'll be able to get the code and get in
Great variety of products,  terrible customer service. I asked about a food product and got a shoulder shrug and was told to look in grocery.
Very good early bird rolls offered for takeout during this pandemic with a great spicy seafood soup order was accurate and on time great takeout

So disappointed, took my wife for our anniversary dinner, my fourth time and her first so I was super excited to take her there. Best part of the night was the show and service, food was nothing to rave about. I didn't share my disappointment with the food with her until she mentioned her food. Both of our dishes had no flavors and came out barely warm. For that price range restaurant people usually go for a specific reason/event, the food and service should always be on point.

Will not be back. Strike one. Little girl manager never fixed my account nor called me like she said she would. Strike two. I don't like the new setup because you can't see what seafood is fresh before ordering. Strike three. I specifically stated I only want to pay an extra $1.50 for half of an avacodo if it was fresh. They assured me it was. Get back to the office and avacodo is brown.  I spent $15 for a poke bowl, no drink and $1.47 tip.

Terrible customer service. Went to drive thru, was ignored after 3 attempts to order. Cashier was very rude and when I called to talk to a manager, I was again disrespected and so called manager could barely speak English. NEVER WILL GO BACK
Fantastic lunch menu and very reasonably priced. Great service and conveniently located from I75 in Ruskin, FL. Will travel to the restaurant again from Lakewood Ranch.

Your usual neighborhood fast food joint.  Another one of the places we've been coming to for years.  Decent food at good prices.  Good burgers, ribs and Gyros.  Fast, friendly service.  The Gyros come with actual tzaziki sauce, not the sour cream that some cheaper places might use.  Delivery now available via Doordash and Grubhub.

Great place to grab a cold draft of your favorite brew and something to eat. This is attached to the Drury Hotel which makes it convenient if staying here.... although the Drury has a free evening happy hour! Great place for Jaye's retirement party!
Omg I had the Bandeja Antioqueña and it was so delicious exactly what I needed in my life. Next time I'm in the area I will definitely be stopping by again.
Our server was excellent and attentive. There were 5 of us - 4 from out of town and we loved the food , ambiance and service. I especially like the poke

Daisy dukes is located right outside of the hotel that I stayed in. It was great and convenient. They offered inside dining, outside dining and take out. We used them for breakfast daily because the hotel wasn't offering breakfast due to COVID. we always got our breakfast to go and ate it inside  of our hotel room. You do get a lot for your money and the order was always accurate and they packed everything you needed in that bag. Utensils, condiments etc... and last but not least the breakfast tasted great!!!!

Long lines = rushed service and rushed product. I Just wasn't blown away by my experience like some are. Just basically a funnel cake or elephant ear. It was in a really cool location by the river. Prices are very reasonable. I didn't like that it was cash only.. but seems to be the standard for a lot of the French quarter.

Fantastic place. The Sharwama is well cooked and tasty. Portion size is decent as well. Beautiful place as well. They have some lovely tapestries from the Middle East on the walls and the Arabic music playing in the background makes the place immersive.

I'll start saying that your coffee sucks, i ordered on uber eats, a mcmuffin, 2 breakfast burritos, 2 coffees, an apple pie and 3 cookies. And i received a mc griddle, 2 burritos, 2 horrible coffees(almost water) an Apple pie and NO COOKIES at all... i spect better for a chain like you guys... disappointing

It was brought to my attention that Chad the owner of Sambos has decided to re-brand.   Thank you!! Please understand that the name truly was created from the original owners names and Chad is the grandson of the founder.   But I agree that this is the time to put the name to bed.   I'm sure that it was an emotional decision.  

Now:  I think "Chads At The Beach" has a nice ring to it.

I celebrated by having breakfast there, Eggs Benedict....wonderful as always!

Great service, coffee African honey caffeine free and chai tea was hot and delicious.  The pastries were dry definitely won't buy these, we have before was hoping they'd improve but it was the same quality will not purchase them next time if there is one.

Well I have tried to contact yall but like the restaurant it seems like your either understaffed or you just don't care. I have tried to contact yall at olive gardens guest relations.com five time and have gotten no response. So this is the only place I can get your attention.

I'm so incredibly happy to see Dig (or Dig Inn as I still fondly think of it) in Philly after becoming obsessed with it in New York. I mean, hearty delicious food and great value, what more could you ask for? My bowl component go-tos are usually the mac n cheese, Brussels sprouts, charred chicken, and farro with a side of pesto sauce. 

I've only taken it to go so far, but the restaurant itself is spacious and relaxed, so I'll definitely dine in sometime.

The food was cold, the hashbrowns were burnt, and the beans had no flavor.....Let's not forget about the huge cockroach crawling up the wall of our booth. I give 1 star for the 10 dollar champagne bottle. Otherwise it'd be a 0 from me.

Purchased food for Fathers Day and received horrible service from the General Manager Paul Nelson.  Ordered a pound of crab legs and was unhappy with the portion i voiced that and asked for a refund of just $60 sumn for crab legs.  He seemed agitated that I asked for my money back and stated that it was a pound.  I simply asked for money as I didn't believe it was and it wasn't up for debate. I also asked for his name and corporate number as it seemed to be a problem.  He yelled the spelling of his name so fast that I couldn't catch it and I asked him to slow down and he told me to figure it out.  I've been calling corporate and leaving messages with no return call.  I will not let this die down as he should be reprimanded for his actions. He took it as far as after i cursed him out being upset after the comment he made(who wouldn't) told me I would be banned and he harassed me as I walked out.

This is by far my favorite location.  The staff there is wonderful. They get excited with me when a new coffee comes out. They pay attention to which bag I buy, and then ask me on my next visit for a review. They suggest new coffees to me, and so far haven't let me down with my home brew. They make my latte perfect every day.  When I say "thank you" they always respond. Many other locations don't pay attention when you talk to them, but not this one, they always engage and respond. The store is always clean too!  I come in pretty often so it feels like my neighborhood Cheers (I don't drink alcohol but I have a strong coffee habit). There is a group of older people who come in every day and sit at the same table. We chat now while I wait for my coffee. It's just a fantastic environment, with exceptional employees who always have time to talk about coffee with me.

I love the food but it's winter....TURN Off THE AC!!!!!!  We have been here three times in the past month and each time it has been uncomfortable to the point that we had to put on our coats.  Unacceptable.

This place has been our go to restaurant for a delish and flavorful meal on the way home from running errands. The desert rose shawarma pita sandwich is amazing. Try all the sides! We love to  add on an order of hummus, olives and grape leaves. Always worth the price because you get more than one meal out of it.

I'm going to start with Meghan our waitress was amazing! Their prices are reasonable! The Ahi Tuna appetizer it was really great. Meghan didn't offer us the specials of the day but that's OK her personality and customer service made up for it. I had the salmon which was very very good my friend had the 8 ounce filet mignon but he really enjoyed.  cleared his plate the sweet potato croquettes he enjoyed said it was like a doughnut. I had half carafe of Woodbridge Chardonnay $16 cant  beat that price. They had on masks and practiced social distancing. Wonderful outside seating and great for sunset dining

We were recommended Finney's from a couple other RESTAURANTS in Santa Barbara. The flavor is so so good. I had the steak tacos and the horseradish aioli was crazy good. Impossible sliders taste like beef 100%. Dakota was our server and she was super sweet, always looking to make sure her tables were happy. She was great, food was great...super glad we came.

I wrote my original review a quite few years ago regarding their awesome pizza and IMO they still consistently deliver the best pizza in town! Just wanted to update my fellow Yelpers on the rest of their Italian gastronomic offerings as I have now had the chance to sample a lot more... and have never been disappointed. Let's start with the pasta dishes..... The Plum offers all the classic Southern Italian mainstays, such as Manicotti, Stuffed Shells, Lasagna as well as a specially
priced dinner for 2, your choice of pasta accompanied by and meatballs or sausage, salad and bread. We like the angel hair pasta tossed with their perfectly balanced marinara sauce. The Italian sausage has just the right mix of spices, not to hot or sweet. The meatball is delicious but a bit less spicy. Actually, the lasagna tasted pretty much like the angel hair and meatball but with the added flavors of ricotta and melted mozzarella cheese. 

The portions are so huge that two can share. 

Their Greek salad, especially with their proprietary blend of potato salad and home made dressing is my favorite!

And they also offer many more entree choices to keep me going back, veal and chicken parmesan or marsala, seafood entrees and more! Stay tuned for my next  update!

We love this place. We visit Tucson every 1-2 years and this is a must visit restaurant. We also get the pitcher of Sangria and it doesn't matter what you order, it's all GREAT. You do need to have the bacon wrapped prawns, WOW, they are the best appetizer we've had.

You know how some restaurants are known for food that strays from their "core"?  Like the bakery in Media that's a gelato Mecca?  Or the gas station in Malvern with fabulous chili?  I call these "Say What?" places. Ardmore's addition to this phenomenon is Ardmore Pizza's hamburgers, club sandwiches, and fresh salads.  Yes, fresh salads at a pizza place.  Delivered.  All of these items arriving quickly, well packaged and, in the case of the burger, still warm.  Bonus is that they're all quite good! 

Our personal favorites are the bacon cheeseburger, the roast beef club and the chicken Caesar salad.  

So when you're craving a decent burger, basic salad or sandwich but don't want to go out or wait forever for a 3rd party delivery service to deliver at best lukewarm food (including lukewarm salad ewwww), give Ardmore Pizza a shout - or order online.  Enjoy our contribution to the "Say What?" community.

**This is a COVID restriction-era review**

My parents (& sister on break from college) live in Somersett and have told us how impressed they were with Sakana for Reno sushi. So last night my sister, fiancé and I went for dinner. 

We called ahead of time to make sure they had outdoor seating (they allow indoor, it's just out of my comfortability). They have a nice, covered patio that wraps around two sides of their building and out of the 8-10 (??) tables they had, we were the only ones sitting outside. Note: all you can eat sushi is ONLY available inside! Regular service/regular menu is available outside. We wished they would have had music outside- the ambiance is sad compared to the poppin Tap House next door. 

Our server was wearing a mask (from a nurse, please keep your nose inside of your mask!!!) and was very friendly and attentive. 5 stars for service!

We started with a glass of fume blanc ($8) and sauv blanc ($9)- fiancé gives "10 stars for drink prices"- and we ordered a house salad, gyoza and hamachi kama to share. The hamachi kama wasn't on the menu (Haley saw a yelp review picture) but was $7.99 and very good. We didn't care for the gyoza as it was deep fried, not pan fried as we had assumed. And the biggest disappointment of the night was the $5 house salad. See my pictures for the description of the salad and the small plate of plain cabbage that came out. Literally. Plain. Cabbage. If they ran out of all the other salad ingredients that's fine, but we shoul

It is very good authetic Italian and the have everything from pizza to pasta to hot or cold sandwiches. Their lunch specials are priced well too. I keep meaning to check out their other location but it's just too far!

The girl who took my order could not have cared any  less. I ordered BONE IN lemon pepper wings. She rang me up for boneless. We were the ONLY people here and told us it would take 20 minutes for the food.  I realized they were boneless wings when I opened it and asked. She said I didn't ask for bone in. I assured her I did because who eats boneless wings with a dry rub? I asked how long it would take to get a new order, she said another 20 minutes. I don't have that time to wait on my lunch break so I did not end up eating lunch. I understand mistakes happen however she just didn't give a shit. Should have expedited my order.

3.5/5

Without question, one of the best places to enjoy a family vacation on St Pete Beach is at the Don Cesar. The beautiful, pink, beach castle is simply majestic elegance. And without question, when you are there, you just don't want to leave.

With a handful of dining options, Sea Porch stands out as the place for every meal (breakfast, lunch and dinner served here); Just don't expect a whole lot from this place. The food is good, not great or special. And while it offers a decent variety, it simply doesn't wow you-- like the hotel does. Decent food at high prices is not typically a winning combination. 

But perhaps they know that. They know that people will always want to visit the Don. They know that people will not want to leave the Don to grab a bite to eat...and this trickery worked on us.

So when you inevitably go to the Don for a beach weekend, and come to the realization that its simply more convenient to eat at Sea Porch then venture elsewhere, perhaps give these Goat Cheese Fritters a go. Served with basil oil and jalapeño champagne gastric, this appetizer is pretty good- but like I said, the other options just dont live up to the elegant beach side setting. 

Just the everyday father giving you his perspective...what you do with it is completely up to you. Eat Well Friends. Cheers

Oceana Grill is an amazing must stop location for any customer local or tourist. They serve amazing meals well into the evening hours. Our party was seated immediately inside their beautiful upstairs dining room with a view of the holiday decorations and lights of the New Orleans street below. The menu is amazing and frankly I'm sure everything will please. That said we went with the recommendations of our superb server Breana and we were not disappointed! Try the alligator bites for a starter, followed by just about any entree and follow it up with their amazing bread pudding! You will be happy you stopped!

I've beed to this cute restaurant several times by now. I came here for lunch, happy hour and dinner. Food is consistently delicious, with a nice selection of small plates for a happy hour. Servers are very friendly and attentive, and at the same time not annoying with their attention. They have a beautiful back patio which I've never been at. At this time of the year it's pretty hot outside, but I definitely want to check it out. Parking space is, unfortunately, limited. It was OK for happy hour, but I had a hard time parking for lunch and dinner.

Interesting fact about this restaurant is that it used to be a police station. Restaurant is very cute and cozy, you will never tell it used to be something else. But they kept one of the cells in its almost original condition - they turned it into a unisex bathroom. 

Overall, great experience, great food and drinks. Definitely worth of checking it out.

Not the most extensive menu selection, but the food was still AMAZING nonetheless!! Very good price point for what you are buying, and the lack of pretty presentation of the food is made up for with the amazing taste. Definitely not a place you would look at and run into, but if you manage to come across it GO! the inside is beautiful, they have old vhs movies lined up and discs along with records, and they even had a movie (The Craft) playing for us when we arrived!! great environment, great customer service, great tasting-food!

We had a reservation then wanted to add 3 more. They were over the top accommodating. What a great addition to the downtown restaurant scene. Service is top notch and the food was out of sight. Loved the fact that Chef Anne Kearney stopped by our table. I've already made return reservations!!

This was genuinely the worst restaurant I have EVER been to. We waited over 2 hours for our food. Our waitress (who was not wearing a mask) told us 3 times, "I swear to God your food is coming up next," but it took an hour after the first time she said that. When we asked for a discount at the end of our absolutely horrible meal, she said "Um.....I can go ask her," came back, and said she could give us 15% off. Additionally, our burgers and chicken club gave me and each person I was with food poisoning. I have never felt so sick in my life. Additionally, the bathroom was completely flooded. Proceed with caution!!! HORRIBLE experience. The city of Nashville should shut this restaurant down.
Food here was hot and fast. I am not a big Thai fan, but would come back again.

My family has been eating pizza every Saturday night for the last 20 years and our favorite spot recently closed so we have been on the lookout for a new place to try. We tried Three Brothers on Saturday and it was exceptional. The pizza was great; the service was outstanding and the atmosphere clean and comfortable.  It was TOP SHELF all around. We found our new spot!

service was good, waitress super friendly and food came out quickly! food was delicious. got about 6 pieces of garlic bread for $3 and a couple of slices of cheesy bread in addition. I got chicken parmesan and my boyfriend got the lasagna--both tasted great and were large portions. Also want to note that all entrees came with a side salad - choice between ceasar and house. 
all in all, great food at a good price in a quieter part of the quarter. def worth a visit.

I am so glad we finally got around to trying this. From the road, this place looks like the kinda place ou would not expect much from, but don't judge a book by its cover. The food here is incredible. The portions on the sandwiches are huge. I feel that it is kinda insulting to call these master pieces "sandwhiches". The flavors that are developed in such a simple meal are tremendous.

The staff is quick and friendly and the menu is very simple. It appears getting carryout is pretty common, but if you nest inside you can sit there and smell all the amazing flavors coming out of the kitchen. And then when the food comes out you get to stare in envy as you await your masterpiece to arrive. 

They also have bottled beer which is a lovely touch if you want to kick back and take your time while you eat. I only wish I lived closer to be able to enjoy one of these at least once a week.
Megu has been a family favorite for many years. The takeout is as good as dining in, and the food is spectacular! I absolutely love Megu.

Im a big fan of Johnnys - I understand the craziness going on right now but I ordered at 7:30pm on grubhub which is normally great and at 9:15 I called for a status update and they told me "oh our grubhub printer isn't working we aren't doing those tonight." ... So after waiting an hour and a half we find this out ... I just feel like as an establishment you need to know to turn off your grubhub status when the printer doesn't work (which is an option) Total ball drop by the place. You have to better than that. 3-5 day wait for a refund now and 4 hungry people. Just upsetting from a place I really like.

I have eaten here since I was old enough to eat this kind of food, it has always been amazing, and I highly recommend the roast beef fully dressed with a Boylan root beer or a hot sausage patty also fully dressed. Whenever I'm back in town I always get the biggest craving to stop by! I have many fond memories here and always recommend this place to anyone and pretty much everyone!

Third visit to New Orleans. We went to the Bourbon House each time but unfortunately we were very disappointed this time.  There was no indication on the menu that there were two sizes to the bourbon milk punch but when we questioned the price on the bill we were informed that we got the larger size hence more expensive.  My son wanted the  $38 fillet but they were unable to accommodate a request for a different sauce since the one included on the menu had shellfish which my son could not eat so he got the brisket.  My house specialty red fish came with two small potatoes and nothing else.  Meals don't even come with salads. The waiter was arrogant and unfriendly. The only good thing about this meal was the appetizer and bread!

Those tamarindo chiltepin wings are super delicious, it's not cheap but every order comes with fries! Very nice, hard working people and very fast! The Chile chamoy sauce it's very interesting but good if you like to try new things.

I can not get enough of this place ! It's becoming a once a week thing . I love the food, customer service and the strawberry lemonade . Very clean establishment and friendly people . My only thing is I wished they stayed open later so I can get it whenever I want it . My go it would be the creole queen ( can't miss with that one ) . Also they have really good wings .

Deviled Pig never misses a beat. My bf and I split the ribs, mac and cheese, and baked beans. I also added a side of the collard greens. 

Listen...don't knock 'em till you tried 'em! Their collards are SUPER impressive. My mom AND grandma would kill me if they knew I said this BUT...I must say, Deviled Pig's greens could EASILY be mistaken for one of their's. I get them every time we order and don't rave about them on yelp enough! Seasoned to perfection...

Ummm yes go here for your burger and shake needs. Straight up burger SPOT. Nothing fancy, just good food. Could, should, (was?) be on Diners Dives & Drive in's. Perfect place to let your kids walk up from the beach and grab lunch. Lots of other options to choose from too, worth the wait in line 

And... they actually wrote a reply to my review! Great place & great people! Good ol' home town food and people

Try the steak fajitas! The steak was savory, medium rare, and plentiful! Margaritas were also great. Solid service and fun overall vibe/ambiance to the restaurant. Chips and queso were respectable. Had a great meal to start off a recent weekend in Music City at Saint Anejo. Would recommend for anyone looking for a margarita and Mexican food. Also reasonably priced !

This place never disappoints. Wonderful atmosphere, wonderful people, and amazing food!  We chose the Buca small meal for 4 adults because we were not super hungry.  We chose the quadro Al forno meal and added a house salad. We also ordered some garlic bread bread.  Everything was cooked perfectly and the pasta was absolutely amazing! The fresh flavors abound at every bite.  The service was very good with just the right attentiveness. They also did a good job with social distancing as well as all servers wearing masks. Wonderful visit all around and we can't wait to go back!

First time ordering take-out and it was delicious!  People were spaced out eating outside and only a few tables inside, the staff were masked and gloved.  Very friendly and helpful staff.  Food was yummy!  Nice size portions, gyro platters could've been shared.  The lamb burger was huge and good, but would've been better eating in the restaurant right away.  The meat pastry I loved as it wasn't salty which can happen.  The pork chops had great flavor, but a tad dry.  If you have to wait for a table, you can easily walk by the shops on the street.  Suggestion:  lamb gyro as an alternative to pork or chicken.  We'll definitely be back!!

So here is why they get 2 stars. I came to eat here because the breakfast has always been good and I decided to have lunch today. That said I ordered a chicken salad sandwich.....simple enough right, WRONG! After being closed for 5 days and reopening today you would think they would have all items on the menu ready to be ordered well I guess not. I guess only certain items on the menu are available on there reopening day. So I ordered the Nashville Hot chicken sandwich which was mediocre at best. And to top it off the service was horrible and slow. The server  seemed to have forgotten about the table I guess.I guess I should have opted for the buffet instead. Word of advice to the manager or whomever does the ordering of food at Moby's..........when reopening after 5 days of being closed have all menu items ready to be ordered and not limit customers to something they may not want!

So apparently you have to make reservations 60 days in advance, oops. But it was worth standing in line, in the cold, to get seats for the second seating, at the bar! Arriving at 4:15 and we were too late for the first seating(restaurant opens at 5 and there are 22 seats available for the walk in bar seats). Lucky for us we were numbers 24 and 25! The hostesses are lovely and have their work cut out for them. They calmly and kindly take everyones phone numbers and if you are getting seated you get a 10 minute check in text. Just go get a drink nearby and wait. 

The food.....holy hummus! Everything was excellent. The reviews are accurate- the salad sampler and hummus are must try appetizers. The fried cauliflower yep cauliflower was mouth watering. The branzino was perfection. Didn't get to try the lamb as they were out of it by the time we ate but if I'm ever in Philly again I'll hopefully visit again and get to try it!!

If you want some authentic Cajun food that's well seasoned and plentiful, this is your place. I'm giving a four-star rating instead of five only because I do think they could cut back a little on the seasoning, and believe me I am a woman who loves seasoning on her food, but if you eat this a couple of times a week your blood pressure may just go through the roof. All that to say, if you're visiting from out of town or just local and want some really good seafood or turkey necks or Poboy 's, this is a great place to go. They have two lines which consist of mainly boiled foods like turkey necks, sausage, potatoes and shrimp fried rice, and they have another line to place orders out of the kitchen like Poboy's and other made-to-order foods. During crawfish season, this is a great place to get your crawfish. They also sell crabs. There's always a line at this place because the food is just that good, but they move things along very quickly. If you've never tried it, just try it. I think you'll be delighted and will surely return again for more.

New to Nashville and our first time at Courtney's. Great home made food and excellent company. If you are looking for a place to come for good food and conversation with people you have never met... this is the place. Live music on Friday, Saturday and Sundays. Come on over and support a local business we will definitely be regulars.

We recently found out about this restaurant and I am so happy we did! The food is freshly cooked and delicious. We have ordered the red and green curry, pad Thai and fried rice.  Be sure to specify your spice level- the medium def had a kick for me! Our family tried it as well and they all enjoyed it!

Let me preface this by saying I worked at the Orlando Ale House for 5 years, many moons ago. So, to me, it's nostalgic food from my "youth." If you consider your 20's youth (god I'm old). 

I digress.

Is the Ale House gourmet cuisine? No. Is it fine dining? Absolutely not. It is, however, a place to go have good fatty bar food & not feel bad about it. Yes, they have salads...but why waste your time? Get the Zingers & get them hot. 

Service was great today! I don't eat here often, because see fatty food description above, but I haven't had bad service at an Ale House anywhere. I myself was an outstanding server. 

Thanks for coming to my Ale House Ted Talk.
Solid shrimp pad Thai. Definitely one of our favorite take out places in Trolley Square :)

Came to Here to eat. First time since the Covid. Our server very nice. Food alway great. He had gloves and a mask on. He never changed his gloved. He sipped down tables and bussed a couple of table and then got our water with ice. He never changed his gloves and scooped out the ice with his hand into our cup. Then he got me a new soda and took my straw and put it into my new glass. This is why this place gets 2 stars

I've driven by this place many times and finally decided to stop in.  I'm glad I did, the girl working out front was very helpful and patient with me.  
The inside isn't much to look at, but what they have in the cases looked great!
There were a lot of goodies to choose from, but I kept it simple.  I went with double chocolate, chocolate chip and Reese's pieces cookies, brownies, peanut butter brownies, chocolate and vanilla cupcakes and a large Bavarian pretzel shaped treat that tasted like black cherry chocolate heaven.  
Everything was delicious.  The chocolate chip cookies were amazing, if you like the mini Entenmann's soft chocolate chip cookies you'll devour these.  The pretzel shaped treat was soft, flaky and had great flavors.  The brownie was very rich, chocolaty and soft, the PB brownie was a little dry, but had decent flavors.  
The doughnut selection was pretty much gone by 1pm, but the girl said if you call a day before they can make an order for you to pick up the next day.  
My co-workers and kid really appreciated the treats from here and I was hooked on those chocolate chip cookies.  I'll definitely be back!

I always come back for the pulled pork outstanding. Sides are great.
Take out a pound great way to have lunch.
Love this restaurant, the menu is special all that I have tastEd is amazing, the combination the flavor the price quality it is good
Authentic place with the bombest tacos! Mexican music, Spanish speaking employees and cute little place. The salsas are bomb too! Definitely coming here again!

Not your typical ramen place, but it in a good way! They most certainly add their own little twist to ramen and you can definitely see it through their menu item names. 

Meow meow bowl: 7/10 Very similar to tonkotsu ramen flavors. Broth was very rich inflavor. The pork belly was perfectly tender. It was actually one giant slice, compared to most places giving 4 thinly sliced pieces. It was a pleasant surprise. The amount of noodles they give is less than normal. And I actually ran out of noodles half way through cuz I didn't realize how little they give. So I had to eat just meat towards the end. Their Bamboo shoots are super tender and tasty. I normally hate bamboo but I ate most of theirs. 

My boyfriend ordered the Chinese take out. I tasted the broth. I didn't really like the ginger taste. But my boyfriend like it a lot and even said this place is better than Jinya. 

Parking is wild. Everyone kind of just parks on the side of the road by the restaurant and the nearby neighbor hood. 

We went on a Tuesday night at 8. And we had about a 15 minute wait because the restaurant is incredibly small. 

Very unique place to try out for sure!

As I was traveling through Indianapolis, I had to check out the local food scene at a popular spot called the Mile Square.  It seems like when I was searching Yelp, almost every highly rated restaurant was in this area.  After much consideration, I chose BRU Burger Bar.

Parking was a challenge as I had to park a block down the street so be prepared for that, even on a Sunday.

The inside decor was nice and reminded me more of a Perkins than a burger dive.  This place was packed to and I would have had to wait 25 minutes if I chose a table.  Luckily, a spot at the bar came open.

After some help from the bartender, I chose the Mexicali BBQ burger and onion rings.  The Mexicali burger came with queso, homemade BBQ sauce, grilled jalapenos, guacamole, lettuce, and tomato.  The burger's patty was thinner than I thought it would be.  Overall, the burger was good but nothing memorable.

On the other hand, the onion rings were some of the best I have ever had.  They were beer battered.  I think a reason they were so good was because they came with housemade ketchup. It wasn't overly sweet like most ketchup. It was also more thin and tangy.  I also requested black pepper mayo, which was the best of the 3 sauces I requested, and honey chipotle BBQ, which really brought out the beer taste in the onion rings.

I would make a stop at BRU again for the onion rings and the decent burger.
Really nice location - small, open kitchen. Food was amazing. Great service. Not cheap but it was worth it. BYOB helps a lot

We go here every time we are in town!  A family favorite!  We have never been disappointed with the service or the food!  Large portions and delicious food!  Son always gets the corn flake crusted French toast and is always stuffed!  Omelettes are amazing!  Can't go wrong!

This is one of the best breakfast places I have ever been to! 
I am a huge foodie (especially for breakfast) so finding this little gem was an amazing experience. 
Best grits i've ever had in my life, super creamy and the perfect consistency. 
The gravy is top tier and has a little bit of a kick which adds so much flavor. 
I will definitely be coming back here in the near future!

Very friendly staff! Loved the atmosphere. They also offer food through a food-truck kind of situation. Food was good too and the entire experience was very touchless friendly. Definitely worth the late night trip.

This was once a favorite for us. 
Their food is still pretty good but we have had enough messed up orders to where we won't go back.  They seem less apologetic with each time. I know they won't miss our business so this falls on deaf ears

If I could give less stars I would! This place is absolutely trash and such a horrible experience! The staff are dirty and rude and are no help whatsoever. They gave us a large fry which was not fresh without any salt! When we informed them they made it seem as if it was our fault the fries had no salt and rudely gave us salt packets! It's not hard to do this job I once worked at a McDonald's and never treated people the way they did. I also ordered a hot and spicy mcchicken with extra mayo and pickles when I opened my sandwich I was extremely disappointed to see there were no pickle no extra mayo and... no lettuce... what are you doing back there Mcdondals employees where you can not simply do your job! It's not rocket science! I will not be returning to this location as I would advice others to not go there as well!

Right before going here, I commented to our group how great Nashville is and how wonderful the people are..Everyone is so kind and welcoming.. Then we made the biggest mistake of our trip & stepped foot in the Mellow Mushroom. where we were waited on by Rebecca. Who was pretty much the most miserable person alive.. She was so nasty and rude.. I'm not sure why she is working in this industry...I hope she can get some help...

Had a great experience, building is right next to water and each floor has it's own menu.  The bartenders on the second floor were extremely friendly and helpful.  We started with beer and a mimosa.  They many beers on tap, including local craft.  Once we finally decided we had th Godzilla roll, they have sushi on second floor.  Godzilla was delicious, displayed well.  We then had the nachos which are great, come covered in pulled pork.  Split between the two of us we left full, and I do not get full easily.

This is my favorite dessert shop in New Orleans!  And, clearly, it's a lot of other people's favorite shop too because it's never NOT packed.

They're known for their gelato and pastries, but I only go there for the pastries.  The tiramisu is always my go-to item.  The "baba rum cake" is my boyfriend's favorite.  We also like their macaroons, biscotti, and various cookies too!

This place is fantastic, but my only complaint is that they're kind of expensive.  The tiramisu and rum cake are pretty small helpings and they're almost $4 each.  Still, I guess that's in the average range for dessert shops around here!

This is my go to Jewish Deli and place to get my lox. It is so damn good. Everything I've ever eaten here has been amazing. A perk also that it is family run.

Sometimes, however, it is hard to get noticed when you walk in, but that doesn't bother me as much, as the food is totally worth it!

We had an absolutely amazing experience with City BBQ last night! To start of... So so so good!!! Everything we got was great! And the service was awesome! They weren't able to fully fill our pickle chip order so they asked us to wait and gave us another one to make up for the first. Then they also gave us a banana pudding to make up for the wait! Happy staff and a great atmosphere given the circumstances. We will be back!

Brought a couples friends here from NYC. The concept is really cute. It's a small 3level lounge type setting. The first floor is a typical bar setting. The 2nd floor is a lounge area and the decor resembles a library/book store. The 3rd floor is another bar with a few sitting options. The drink/food menu comes stapled to pages of a book, giving a feel of "reading in a library." I love that they have mocktails; a breath of fresh air from having to order the typical soda options.

Ordered a 16 inch pepperoni for $14 and a 10 inch gluten free pepperoni for $11. You can see the comparison in the photo. I get that gluten free options are usually pretty mediocre in this city but if you're in downtown St Pete please step up your game. It was thin and puny and I was still hungry after. My boyfriend liked the regular pizza though and had good things to say about it, so that's a plus. For regular pizza, go there. For gluten free, skip it.
First time there Triple  D was correct. The food was great and the service timely. The meal was well worth the wait . I had a Roberto Clemente and it was on the money. Loved it. I will be back
Love the snow crab with garlic it's such a treat. Wait staff is so friendly and helpful. Pretty perfect place for a family meal.

Excellent restaurant for tapas, overall I was very impressed with the cooking and flavors associated with the dishes. The pulpo is out of this world delicious, it tasted and felt like it was freshly caught out of the ocean. I had the croquettes, ibérico sausage, the shrimp(ajillos) in oil, and the potatoes in a creamy sauce. The only reason this place does not get 5 stars is because the churros were under seasoned, but they were perfectly cooked. Drink selection is vast, so enjoy!

This place is gringo mex nasty!
The food was cold and tasteless.
Look for something else that's authentic.

Went on New Year's Eve around 6:30- made the reservation for regular seating, was pushed into high top. Husband got knocked into several times, we were all so packed in. Food was bland, portions small, lentil soup had about 5 lentil beans in it. Even the table next to us asked for salt shaker. Bill was outrageous. Noise level off the chart. One and done.

We were excited to share Vivo with our family and made reservations for New Year's Eve.  We were seated and had time to peruse the menu when the server came to our table and advised that one of our guests did not meet their "dress code."  I will say that all of our party were nicely dressed, clean, and respectable.  And have, as a group, eaten in many fine establishments with no problems regarding dress.  As the guest would not be able to dine we had to leave.  We did speak to the manager and were able to get our reservation fee refunded but we had to find another option for our supper on New Year's Eve at 7 pm.  We had not been advised of a dress code when making the reservation and, to this date over a year later, there is no mention of a dress code on any of their materials.  The food is good but is easily matched by a number of other restaurants in Edmonton with far less pretentious atmospheres and management.

I absolutely love coming to this restaurant. The service is great and the food is even better. I come here when I don't want to be disappointed. They serve brunch on the weekends until 3. I got the country fried steak and the portion was huge. A good bang for the buck. The cocktails are absolutely delicious. I also tried the queso which was very smooth. If you're in Nashville visiting I definitely recommend.

Every year I've come here whenever i visit reno,  but that might end with this trip.  
First off,  there were some good points.  The rooms were very good, everything clean and neat.  However,  having housekeeping pound on my door at 930am when I've been gaming all night.  Then again at 10am, told them i was still busy, proceeds to open the door anyways(maybe they didn't hear me? ) and once they saw i was in the room they slammed the door shut.  
The big disappointment of the entire trip was the poker room being closed(one of the main reasons i come down here). Website said they were open,  even listed the tournament schedule. Get to the poker room only to see its closed. 
Covid or not,  that kind of information should be on the website. I eventually found a list online of the current status of the poker rooms within the area.  
Very good chance i won't be coming back for awhile.

Hands down, the worst dining experience that we have ever encountered. And to think, in the heart of Santa Barbara. Don't let the ratings fool you, service here was worst. We came 15 minutes early and got seated at the communal counter and was told we would get a dinner menu and would be seated at 5pm.  As heavily staffed as they were on the front of the house, they seemed too busy talking to each other and we ended up getting left out of the picture.  Of course, we never got a dinner menu and we never got seated for dinner.  And when the food started coming out,  everything was bland.  You would think that you were at a dietary restaurant.  The only thing that my daughter liked was the popcorn. I could've went to a movie theater, if that was the case. Follow up by the manager on duty was even worse.  He seemed clueless how to handle situations where service fails.  Quite sad to see this kind of service in the heart of Santa Barbara.   Service is everything!  Even if the food is spot on, bad service can ruin everything.  Avoid this place.

I gave them four stars last time and I would give them four stars this time. I got the fajita and my wife got shrimp tacos. Both were very tasty. The steak and the chicken in my fajitas were great, tender and tasty. 

My wife said her shrimp tacos were really good as well. Our server was on top of it and brought us our food in a timely manner. Every time we needed something she was there. The only reason I give it a four is they raise the prices I believe. Still a pretty good place to go for dinner.

Absolutely perfect! Patient while we couldn't decide what to order (so many delicious sounding options), generous servings, and some of the very best bbq we have ever had. Also appreciated the outdoor seating considering the pandemic. We had the brisket plate with summer slaw and the cornbread bowl with pork and beef brisket. Out of this world good- definitely a stop you should be making for bbq. We loved that they used pasture raised meats. Bonus-  we got to eat under some shady peach trees which honestly just made our experience even more amazing.

Came by for a quick dinner and had a good experience. Our server was extremely friendly and respectful of the social distancing guidelines. The capriccioca pizza was perfect comfort food and the fettuccine alfredo was good and creamy but could had a little more flavor. The tiramisu was somewhat disappointing because the lady fingers were dry and the dessert tasted very overpowering chocolate. Over all it was nice to sit outside and I would want to return again for pizza for sure.

You can find me at Bonnie's most Saturday mornings.  I go for the breakfast - delicious, nice sized portion, reasonably priced - usually opting for the Quickie scramble or the Veggie Omelette.  But truth be told, I go more for the regularity of the visit.  It's nice to be able to walk into someplace where they know who I am and what my food preferences are when I sit down - sometimes suggesting a special that might (and typically does) appeal to me.  (to the point where even some of the regulars recognize me and ask how my week was!)

This was exactly what I needed without even knowing it. Casual. Simple. Delicious. I had Cuban style pork with coconut rice, plantains and black beans. Everything was so tasty, I ate every last bit. I highly recommend this place.

I've eaten at Mai Lee many times and the food is always excellent. Had dinner there last week and sat at the bar, I was really disappointed with the service. The waiter was on his phone the entire time.....actually took my order while standing at the cash register looking down at his phone.
Very unprofessional.

Whoa. This is the closest poke bowl we have found since our trip to Hawaii. So delicious and fresh! We loved the Aloha Love bowl (succulent pork-based) and the Summer Breeze Bowl (salmon-based). I also really appreciated their precautions in preventing the Covid virus. Can't wait to try all of the other items on the menu!

We had a wonderful experience at Jet City today. Jessica is full of energy and love. The breakfast and coffee were delicious but the service and kindness really amazed us the most. Jessica is so warm and full of life. She played the tin whistle for us and showed us around her charming Air BNB. We were blessed to meet her and her son and will definitely be back. What a great experience!!!
We always make a trip to Hungry Harry's when we are in town. Best ribs ever. Definitely the best BBQ place around.

Not only the best Mexican food in Tampa, but possibly the best Mexican food in the world!  My mother-in-law visited from Mexico, and said that she had the best tamale that she had ever had before at Loli's.  She thought it was funny that she had to travel all the way to Tampa for the best Mexican food!

Best Tacos in Tampa, good costumer service and food is amazing. 
Nopal salad is very yummy.
Highly recommended.
